No. The 67.7 ha tree-cover loss was recorded in **2020**, before the EUDR cut-off date of 31 December 2020.

No loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on the property during 2021–2025. The data did show 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021, which were not counted as events.

This assessment does not establish EUDR compliance or rule out all smaller changes.
